description: This file declares classes related to media key sessions, including a factory class and a session class, for managing digital rights management (DRM) sessions within a media server context. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and private member variables relevant to media key handling, session management, and callbacks.

classes.name: MediaKeySessionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating MediaKeySession instances, implementing IMediaKeySessionFactory.

classes.name: MediaKeySession
classes.description: Represents a media key session, managing DRM interactions and callbacks, implementing IMediaKeySession and IOcdmSessionClient.

methods.name: MediaKeySessionFactory::createMediaKeySession
methods.description: Creates and returns a new IMediaKeySession instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::MediaKeySession
methods.description: Constructor initializing a MediaKeySession object with key system, session ID, ocdm system, session type, client, LDL flag, and main thread factory.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::generateRequest
methods.description: Generates a license request with specified init data type and data.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::updateSession
methods.description: Updates the session with response data.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the CDM key session ID.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key with specified key ID exists.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::setDrmHeader
methods.description: Sets the DRM header with provided request data.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::getLastDrmError
methods.description: Retrieves the last DRM error code.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a key ID for the session.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::isPlayreadyKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if the key system is PlayReady.

methods.name: MediaKeySession::onAllKeysUpdated
methods.description: Handles notification that all keys are updated.
